added.summary: The strategy HUD components ship as TSX beside their component documents: same props, states, strings and accessibility, styled with Tailwind classes and the new UI's primitives. The art keeps its size at any text scale; a cooldown's radial sweep and a queue tile's radial wipe stand in as top-down bars until the radial wipe reaches TSX, and art that the game marks unready dims under a veil instead of a filter.
